polling.after_first_tip: loop continued but fetched 0 games for the remaining window (51 polls, ~9 min log cadence, cause of the slower cadence not determined)

measured_availability.interpretation: For these 2 games ESPN core roster starter flags appeared between ~22 and ~19 minutes before tip and stayed for 7 consecutive polls. Sample is 2 games, one night.

collection_gap_found.what: The 7 games tipping after 00:00 UTC were observed only until 00:00 UTC (last observation 30.5, 60.5 and 90.5 min before tip) and never reached the ~19-min window.
collection_gap_found.root_cause: ESPN scoreboard is keyed by US-Eastern date; code requested the UTC date, so after 00:00 UTC the evening slate was no longer queried.

collection_gap_found.status: both fixed in nba-edge-finder PR #87 head d31d6dd (code and unit tests); live confirmation pending nba-edge-finder run 41943601188
